story.title: Rabbit Goes to a Party
paragraphs_en: Once upon a time, the animals decided to have a party. But it was not for all of them. It was only for the animals that had horns.
The rabbit was getting ready for the party. But then he found out that the party was not for everyone. It was just for animals with horns.
The rabbit went somewhere and got some horns. Then he put them on his head and went to the party.
During the party the rabbit ate and drank and danced.
This made him tired and he fell down in the sun. But while the rabbit was sleeping, the horns fell off!
Then all the animals discovered that the rabbit was not the kind of animal they wanted. So they pulled his ears till they got bigger and bigger.
Then they ran away. And that's the reason why rabbits have big ears!

sentences.text_en: Once upon a time, the animals decided to have a party.
sentences.text_vi: Ngày xửa ngày xưa, các con vật quyết định tổ chức một bữa tiệc.

sentences.text_en: But it was not for all of them.

sentences.text_en: It was only for the animals that had horns.
sentences.text_vi: Nó chỉ dành cho những con vật có sừng thôi.

sentences.text_en: The rabbit was getting ready for the party.
sentences.text_vi: Thỏ đang chuẩn bị đi dự tiệc.

sentences.text_en: But then he found out that the party was not for everyone.
sentences.text_vi: Nhưng rồi thỏ phát hiện ra bữa tiệc không dành cho tất cả mọi con vật.

sentences.text_en: It was just for animals with horns.
sentences.text_vi: Nó chỉ dành cho những con vật có sừng thôi.

sentences.text_en: The rabbit went somewhere and got some horns.
sentences.text_vi: Thỏ đi đến một nơi nào đó và kiếm được vài cái sừng.

sentences.text_en: Then he put them on his head and went to the party.
sentences.text_vi: Sau đó, thỏ đội chúng lên đầu và đi đến bữa tiệc.

sentences.text_en: During the party the rabbit ate and drank and danced.
sentences.text_vi: Trong bữa tiệc, thỏ ăn, uống và nhảy múa.

sentences.text_en: This made him tired and he fell down in the sun.
sentences.text_vi: Điều này làm thỏ mệt mỏi và thỏ ngã xuống dưới nắng.

sentences.text_en: But while the rabbit was sleeping, the horns fell off!
sentences.text_vi: Nhưng khi thỏ đang ngủ, những cái sừng đã rơi ra!

sentences.text_en: Then all the animals discovered that the rabbit was not the kind of animal they wanted.
sentences.text_vi: Sau đó, tất cả các con vật phát hiện ra rằng thỏ không phải là loại con vật mà chúng muốn.

sentences.text_en: So they pulled his ears till they got bigger and bigger.
sentences.text_vi: Thế là chúng kéo tai thỏ cho đến khi tai thỏ to hơn và to hơn nữa.

sentences.text_en: And that's the reason why rabbits have big ears!
sentences.text_vi: Và đó là lý do tại sao thỏ có đôi tai to!
